verse.verse_3: How will you comprehend what the startling calamity is? --
verse.verse_4: A Day on which human beings would be like so many scattered moths,
verse.verse_5: The mountains like the tufts of carded wool.
verse.verse_6: Then he whose deeds shall weigh heavier in the scale
verse.verse_8: But he whose deeds are lighter in the balance
verse.verse_9: Will have the Abyss for abode.
verse.verse_10: How will you comprehend what that is?
